command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
from urllib.error import HTTPError

def call(payload, raw=None):
    data = raw if raw is not None else json.dumps(payload).encode()
    req = Request("http://127.0.0.1:5000/sentiment", data=data, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST")
    try:
        with urlopen(req) as r:
            status, body = r.status, r.read().decode()
    except HTTPError as e:
        status, body = e.code, e.read().decode()
    print(status, body)
    return status, json.loads(body)

s, p = call({"text": "I absolutely love this product, it is fantastic!"})
assert s == 200 and p["sentiment"] == "positive" and set(p["confidence"]) == {"positive", "negative"}

s, n = call({"text": "This is terrible and I hate it."})
assert s == 200 and n["sentiment"] == "negative" and set(n["confidence"]) == {"positive", "negative"}

s, e = call({})
assert s == 400 and "error" in e
s, e = call(None, raw=b"not-json")
assert s == 400 and "error" in e
s, e = call({"text": "   "})
assert s == 400 and "error" in e
s, e = call({"text": 123})
assert s == 400 and "error" in e
print("ALL TESTS PASSED")
PY
